title: Jabariya Jodi
desc: Abhay, a righteous thug, kidnaps greedy grooms who demand dowry and gets them married without it. His childhood love Babli returns, making him rethink his life and priorities.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Woh Bhi Din The
desc: Rohit, a photojournalist, returns to his school as a speaker. He relives his carefree days and the moment he first fell in love, filled with nostalgia.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Dhadkan
desc: Anjali loves Dev, but family pressure forces her to marry Ram. Years later, Dev returns to win her back, only to find she has grown to love her husband.

title: Cirkus
desc: Chaos erupts when two pairs of twins, separated at birth, unknowingly arrive in the same city. Their identical faces spark nonstop confusion, misunderstandings, and hilarious mayhem.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Jersey
desc: Arjun, a gifted yet failed cricketer, makes a daring comeback in his late thirties, driven by his dream of playing for India and fulfilling his son's wish for a jersey.

title: Jawan
desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

title: Akhanda 2: Thaandavam
desc: As biological warfare threatens the country, a scientist seeks a cure. But when dangerous forces target her, a warrior returns to defend humanity.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl, who is speech impaired, lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she belongs to Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.
